INF584 - High Resolution Sparse Voxel DAGs - GitHub
This is an implementation of the reducing an SVO into a Sparse Voxel DAG algorithm from High Resolution Sparse Voxel DAGs. The base code for this implementation is from Out-of-Core Construction of Sparse Voxel Octrees.
